document.title: CarPal MVP — Taxonomy Catalog
document.status: Draft for WP0 approval by the automotive taxonomy specialist and the Product Manager (Plan WP0, Stage 1)
document.purpose: The controlled vocabulary of the MVP (MVP §5.4): vehicle brands, models, series, engine and fuel types, service systems, service tasks, part categories, symptoms, review tags and amenities, with their synonyms, transliterations and weighted mappings. It powers profiles, search, AI matching, skill heatmaps, inventory fitment, service records and review tagging.
document.source_of_truth: This file is the seed source for the taxonomy module (WP4). database/seeds and section 22.6 of 43.db_setup.sql are generated from it. Field rules come from 52 §7; where this file and 52 disagree, 52 wins and this file is corrected.

conventions.key: '<type>:<slug>'. The stable reference inside this file (parent, mappings, synonyms, safety check). The database assigns UUIDs; loaders resolve keys to IDs by (type, slug).
conventions.slug: Latin, ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,78}[a-z0-9])?$. Unique within its type in this catalog, which is stricter than the database rule (type + parent), so every key is unique. Vehicle models and series start with the brand slug; engine families start with the maker slug.
conventions.name: EN and FA both required, 1–120 characters each (52 §2.4). FA uses Persian ی and ک, keeps the zero-width non-joiner, and writes digits as Latin digits (52 §2.5); clients show Persian digits per user preference.
conventions.description: Optional, max 500 characters per locale. Given for service systems so people and AI classify work into the right system.
conventions.parent: Key of the parent node, or null for a root. Parent rules are in node_types and are enforced by the trigger taxonomy_nodes_rules.
conventions.regions: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Empty means global. 'IR' marks Iran-only items for the pilot (Plan §3.5).
conventions.attributes: Only the keys allowed for the type (52 §7); null when the type has none or none are set.
conventions.sort_order: Display order among siblings, starting at 1.
conventions.status: Every node is seeded as 'active'. Later changes (inactive, deprecated, merged) are made through the admin API (40 §23.3), not in this file.
conventions.synonym.script: 'latin' marks Persian typed in Latin letters (transliteration); null otherwise. Matching uses core.normalize_search_text (character variants, digits, ZWNJ, case).
conventions.mapping.weight: Relevance 0–100: how strongly the source points to the target. Triage, the query interpreter and matching rank targets by weight: 70 or more is a primary target, 40–69 a likely alternative, below 40 a weak hint. Launch defaults; calibrated in Stage 7 with the triage evaluation set (WP18, WP21).
conventions.mapping.inheritance: Part subcategories without their own part_category_to_system entry received their parent's entry when this file was built, so every mapping is explicit here. Accessories, roof racks and towing equipment have no service system on purpose.

synonym_types.meaning: Same meaning, different word (gearbox for transmission)
Another name for the same item, often a market or trade name (Persia for Pars)
Common spelling mistake or variant (باطری for باتری)
Persian typed in Latin letters; script must be 'latin' (lent tormoz)

mapping_types.used_for: Help Me triage and direct search: symptom text returns providers through the system (Plan WP8)
Triage summary and appointment draft: likely task for the service category
Parts search and vendor coverage: which repair area a part belongs to
Parts suggestions for a task and fitment context in pre-visit reports

safety_check.rule: The shared safety keyword check runs on Help Me text, search text and appointment request text (52 §7, MVP §7.2A, Plan WP8). After normalization, a text is flagged when it contains a keyword below, or the name or an active synonym of a symptom whose attributes.safety_critical is true. The flag shows the safety banner and routes Help Me to the safety and urgency check (21 C-HELP-05). It never blocks the user and never gives a diagnosis.
safety_check.match: Whole word or whole phrase after core.normalize_search_text; Latin-script keywords match Persian typed in Latin letters.

help_me_shortcut_chips.rule: Chip labels live in the UI dictionary under the given key (52 §2.4); a chip preselects the listed symptoms as tags.

open_issues.topic: Safety keywords in part and service searches
open_issues.issue: The safety word list contains generic words (brakes, steering, ترمز, فرمان). They also appear in normal part and service queries such as 'brake pads', 'لنت ترمز' and the FA name of wheel alignment 'تنظیم فرمان', which would show the safety banner.
open_issues.proposal: Show the keyword-only flag only when the query does not resolve completely to a part_category or service_task node. A match on a safety_critical symptom always flags.

open_issues.issue: Bi-fuel cars are common in the pilot market, but the powertrain enum has no gas value. This catalog models them as fuel types petrol-cng and petrol-lpg with powertrain 'petrol'.
open_issues.proposal: Keep this for the MVP. Add 'cng' and 'lpg' to the powertrain enum only if filtering by gas is needed.

open_issues.issue: Brands, models, series, production years and engine codes are a pilot set. Iran market model names, trims treated as series (Pride 111/131/132/141/151, Dena variants) and engine displacements must be checked before seeding. Missing years and displacements are left out on purpose rather than guessed.
open_issues.proposal: The taxonomy specialist reviews the vehicle section and extends it from a licensed or open vehicle dataset in WP4.

open_issues.issue: ProviderProfile.service_modes already has 'pickup_dropoff' and 'mobile' (52 ProviderProfile). The amenity 'pickup-dropoff' from the starter seed says the same thing.
open_issues.proposal: Keep the amenity for the starter seed but stop offering it in the profile editor; deprecate it after Stage 2.

open_issues.issue: Iran-only nodes carry region IR. The USA or Euro zone launch needs its own regional entries (local brands and models, inspection regimes such as MOT or state inspection, winter tyre rules) and EN regional synonyms.
open_issues.proposal: Add regional nodes and synonyms by configuration when the second region is opened (Plan §3.5); no code change.

change_log.change: First catalog. Expands the starter seed of 43 §22.6 (76 nodes, 16 synonyms, 27 mappings), which is kept unchanged: same slugs, parents, labels, attributes and weights. Adds the pilot vehicle catalog (Iran and global examples), eight service systems (drivetrain, electronics, safety systems, gas fuel system, locks and alarms, interior, detailing, roadside assistance), the full task, part and symptom lists, review tags, amenities, the safety keyword list and the Help Me chip presets.
